scope: Independent full-text, source-bound review of statements, method, category relevance, quotations and conversion limits. This receipt grants no human verification, screening-state change, domain-expert verification or publication authority.

findings.location: Core statements; Research question and method
findings.finding: Both quotations resolve. The source supports six models, 1,273 MedQA-USMLE cases, three-round consultations, three prompting interventions, four temperatures and the dual-system comparison. The statements about biased-error alignment and partial performance recovery are properly bounded to the simulation.

Bias_Ungleichheit and Fairness are unsupported under assessment/categories.yaml. The paper studies patient cognitive framing and diagnostic reliability, explicitly distinct from demographic or structural inequality; it does not evaluate algorithmic fairness. Keep Generative_KI and Prompting, and remove Bias_Ungleichheit and Fairness. The current sentence acknowledging cognitive rather than demographic bias conflicts with calling those categories central.

The simulation, model, dialogue and deployment-safety limits are accurate. Numeric results are available in linearised prose and tables; figure captions corroborate conditions, while no reviewed claim requires interpreting an uninspected plot.
